# Dependencies for Streamlit Community Cloud.
#
# The project is developed with uv, and `pyproject.toml` + `uv.lock` are the
# real source of truth. Streamlit Community Cloud reads neither: it looks for
# requirements.txt, and its pyproject.toml support expects Poetry, which this
# project does not use. So this file is generated rather than maintained:
#
#     uv export --no-hashes --no-dev --no-emit-project > requirements.txt
#
# It is the resolved lock, not a loose list, so the hosted app installs the
# same versions that were tested. The environment markers are uv's -- they are
# what keep the Windows-only packages from being installed on Linux.
